questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (approx 00:08-00:12), exactly three pens are clearly arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented with the cap/clip end at the bottom and the barrel pointing up; they are perfectly aligned.
All three pens share the same dark/black barrel and cap coloration; no color mismatch is observed.
Every pen is fully capped with the clip visible at the bottom; all pens appear to be the same length.
The board moves continuously and smoothly from the left edge to the right edge without pausing or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their slots/positions on the white board throughout the entire transit.

parsed.reason: The video shows a standard production pass with three identical, correctly oriented pens moving smoothly on the carrier board.
